boundary: Official API adapter contract tests only. No developer app mutation, credential use, real OAuth, network call, or external publication occurred.

controls: minimum video.publish scope is inherited from the accepted OAuth profile
ambiguous transfer/status fails to unknown_remote rather than blind retry
published remote id retained when returned

required_actions: owner identifies and approves a TikTok developer app with video.publish/audit state
owner confirms credential addition or change for that app
owner confirms OAuth for a named TikTok account
owner separately confirms publication of a named MP4 with reviewed title, copy and privacy
live_acceptance_gate.reason: These are external authorization, credential and publication actions and were not authorized by this local milestone.
